page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without the overhead of high vCPU counts. The absence of bundled local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, focusing resources purely on memory-intensive processing. This configuration is suitable for memory-intensive applications, including medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that fit within a 64.0 GB memory footprint.
